description: This file is a Bash script for generating a RAG (Red/Amber/Green) status report by parsing YAML metadata files across project components and creating a markdown dashboard. The script collects component metadata, assesses statuses, and produces a structured report with detailed component information and review statuses.

methods.name: yaml_val
methods.description: Parses a top-level YAML key's value from a given file.

methods.name: yaml_nested
methods.description: Parses a nested YAML key's value within a parent key from a file.

methods.name: yaml_review_progress
methods.description: Calculates review progress (reviewed/total) from reviewers section.

methods.name: yaml_reviewer_status
methods.description: Retrieves a specific reviewer's status from a file.

methods.name: review_icon
methods.description: Converts a review status to a symbol for display.

methods.name: component_path
methods.description: Derives component path label relative to repository root.

methods.name: rag_icon
methods.description: Maps RAG status to its unicode indicator.
